verdict.rationale: Omnara lets teams configure which agent actions require approval and pause for human input (omnara-docs-8), plus role-based access controls to restrict who can operate/configure agents (omnara-gh-1), which supports gating repository-modifying actions. However there's no evidence of an explicit upfront 'scope and contract' approval step (e.g., approving a plan/spec before any code changes begin) — the approval mechanism described is generic per-action gating, not a task-scoping contract review workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated scope/plan approval workflow prior to task start, evidence of a spec/contract review UI, and independent confirmation this gating actually blocks repo writes until approved.
